question.problem:
Let ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},…,{X}_{10}$ be I.I.D. random variables with probability density function

$$
f(x)=\theta {x}^{-\theta -1},\,x\ge 1,
$$

where $\theta $ is an unknown parameter. For a particular sample ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{10},$ you're given that 

$$
{\sum }_{i=1}^{10}\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}_{i}≈11.72.
$$

Given that the log-likelihood function of the sample is

$$
l(\theta )=a\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta -b(\theta +1)
$$

What is the value of $a+b,$ rounded to two decimal places?
question.worked_solution:
Recall that if ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},…,{X}_{n}$ are independent and identically distributed continuous random variables with probability density function $f(x;\theta ),$ where $\theta $ is an unknown parameter, then the log-likelihood function of a random sample ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}l(\theta ) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡L(\theta ) \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡({\prod }_{i=1}^{n}f({x}_{i};\theta )) \\  & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}\operatorname{ln}⁡(f({x}_{i};\theta )).\end{aligned}
$$

In our case, we are given a sample of $n=10$ independent random variables with unknown parameter $\theta ,$ for which the probability density function is

$$
f(x)=\theta {x}^{-\theta -1},\,x\ge 1.
$$

Next, we write down the log-density function:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡f(x;\theta ) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(\theta {x}^{-\theta -1}) \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta +\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{-(\theta +1)}) \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta -(\theta +1)\operatorname{ln}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can calculate the log-likelihood function as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}l(\theta ) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}(\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta -(\theta +1)\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}_{i}) \\  & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta -(\theta +1){\sum }_{i=1}^{n}\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}_{i} \\  & =n\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta -(\theta +1){\sum }_{i=1}^{n}\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}_{i}\end{aligned}
$$

We are told that ${\sum }_{i=1}^{10}\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}_{i}≈11.72$ and $n=10.$ Therefore, 

$$
\begin{aligned}l(\theta ) & ≈10\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta -(\theta +1)\cdot 11.72 \\  & =10\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta -11.72(\theta +1).\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, 

$$
a+b≈10+11.72=21.72.
$$
